title: 第2章 金色卡片
content_zh:
楚岩看着自己面前拿着银色手枪的万彩妮，依旧喝着咖啡，眼神在万彩妮身上打量了一番之后笑了笑。

“绑匪先生？你是在说我？”看着万彩妮一本正经的样子，楚岩将手里的咖啡放下，之后一脸不解的问道。

“难道不是么？兜里藏着一叠照片，都是些小孩子，怎么样？目标选好了吗？”楚岩的反应让万彩妮一愣，不过她也清楚，自己是听信了女服务生缇娜的一面之词，所以，这个人到底是不是疑犯，她还需要进一步的试探才能知晓。

“你怎么知道我有一叠照片？哦，明白了，那个白衣女服务生，是她告诉你的吧？”楚岩瞬间便清楚了是怎么一回事“应该是女服务生看见了自己那些照片，然后误认为自己是绑匪所以才会报警，不过看眼前这女人的站姿还有枪械的自由选择性，十有八九是国际刑警之类，只是，国际刑警跑到这个咖啡厅来干什么？抓绑匪也用不着她们这个级别的精英出手吧？”

楚岩心里想什么，万彩妮不知道，但是万彩妮知道的是，自己面前这个身形削瘦但是却异常挺拔的男人，似乎真的有照片，而且那些照片对他来讲意义颇大。

“对，就是那些照片，我很想知道，一个身份神秘的男人，兜里藏着一叠带血的照片，这到底是什么意思，原谅我，我是个警察，所以对这些很好奇，如果你不是绑匪，那么，不妨和我聊聊看，如果你的解释我能接受，那么，我想其他人也一样会接受，对吧？”万彩妮脸上的笑意充满了威胁，当然，笑容的威胁力远远比不上她手里拿着的那把银光闪闪的手枪。

“点51的特制子弹，这么近的距离，我想我的脑袋会被炸成一颗烂西瓜吧。”几乎是下意识的说出了这样一段话，而万彩妮在听到楚岩说出这句话的时候心中居然有些紧张起来，不为别的，就为那句“点51的特制子弹。”。

因为*最常见的只有三种口径，点357，点45和点50，自己这把手枪是花了重金请人改造过的，口径正是比点50还要大一点点的点51口径，全世界仅此一把。

万彩妮很确定楚岩没有碰过这把枪，更没有卸开弹夹去检查里面的子弹，而光凭视觉，就能准确判断出自己手枪的口径，这份眼光有多毒辣她这个国际刑警最清楚，所以她心中没来由的紧张了起来。

与此同时，女服务生缇娜跟在莫夕瑶身后神色紧张的站在了楼梯上。

“莫总，你看，就是那个男人，你看他的眼神，那么冷，那么酷，咳咳...怎么这会看起来不像是坏蛋啊？”女服务生缇娜看着坐在沙发上的楚岩，刀削斧凿一般的刚毅面孔，怎么瞅都充满了正气。

“少发点花痴吧，男人长的帅，不代表他就是好人，在这里等着吧，重案组的黄组长马上就到了，是不是绑匪到时候就会水落石出，你先去下面招呼客人吧，等下警察来了你负责安抚一下客人，别生事端。”莫夕瑶站在楼梯上，仔细打量着面带微笑的楚岩，自己的死党万彩妮此刻已经坐在他对面，两个人好像聊的很开心，当然，如果不是万彩妮左手上那把大号的手枪影响了气氛的话。

“警察！不准动！双手举高，放在让我能看到的地方。”就在万彩妮准备继续问下去的时候，一群人冲进了咖啡厅，十几把刚刚上任没几天的洛洛克17型*将楚岩和万彩妮围了个铁桶一般。

“国际刑警！”万彩妮出示了自己的证件，果然，和楚岩猜测的一样，国际刑警精英分子。

“搜身！”第一时间冲进来的南山市重案一组组长黄凯第一个收回了手枪，这位组长身高足有两米，身形健硕，典型的肌肉男一个，但是此刻的他身上的衣服已经不知道多久没换过了，胡子邋遢的脸上充满了煞气，一双通红的眼珠子更是瞪的牛眼一般，狠狠的盯着楚岩，二话不说便吩咐搜身，之前接到过许多起报案线索，只不过都是误报，搞的他不得不在抓捕疑犯之前确认疑犯的身份以及取得与绑架案相关的证据。

看着周围的警员，楚岩脸上的表情没什么太大的变化，只是眼神却是飘向了众人的身后，在那里，银棕榈咖啡厅的主人莫夕瑶正一脸憎恨的看着楚岩。

“是！”警员大力说着就要搜身，而楚岩则是平静的看着他，眼神里的冰冷让大力的脊梁骨有点发凉，但越是这样，就越是说明眼前这个人不是寻常人，也许这个家伙真的就是绑匪也说不定，想着大力还是把手伸到了楚岩的胸前。

“你凭什么搜我身？”大力的手几乎都已经碰到了楚岩的衣服，楚岩这才淡淡的开了口，平静的面孔上，双眸冷若寒冬。

“凭什么？老子现在怀疑你和三起绑架案有关，怎么样？这个理由够不够？”听到楚岩的话，黄凯顿时就怒了，瞪着血红的眼睛就来到了楚岩近前，伸手就要去戳楚岩的肩头。

“你的意思是你凭空猜测？看着我像绑匪，然后就搜身抓人对吧？”楚岩并不在意黄凯的咆哮，但是声音里的寒意谁都能听的出来，而黄凯的手指也在楚岩的话出口之后，重重的戳在了楚岩的肩头上。

“好！你他妈的还嘴硬，既然你说你不是绑匪，那好，把你兜里的照片拿出来，然后说清楚他们的来历，我就放过你！怎么样？”黄凯已经连续三天三夜没合眼了，现在整个人就像是一个火药桶，一点就着，所以他身边最得力的助手张德昌将这位重案组长一把拉到一边，自己则是冲着楚岩曝出了粗口！

楚岩的眼神一直盯着站在远处楼梯上站着的莫夕瑶，尽管从来没见过面，但是他清楚，自己此行的目标，应该就是那个女人了，至于这些警察，还有那个不知道什么时候已经跑去莫夕瑶身边的国际刑警，楚岩并没有太过在意，毕竟自己是不是绑匪自己心里最清楚，而且一大堆的证据都能够轻易的让自己洗脱嫌疑。

“好吧。”楚岩不准备和这些警察继续纠缠下去，于是伸手从自己兜里准备取出照片，然后解释清楚，只是楚岩没等取出照片，一张黑色的卡片就已经率先掉了出来，那黑色卡片上的一抹金色，让站在远处的莫夕瑶脑袋里“轰”的一声，差意点从楼梯上摔下来。

“黄组长，我想，这可能是一个误会。”莫夕瑶话一出口，所有人都是一愣，尤其是重案组长黄凯，这报警电话可是莫夕瑶亲自打给他的，不然的话他也不会带出这么多兄弟过来抓人。

“莫小姐，你他妈的这是什么意思？电话是你打的，现在又说是误会，耍我是不是？”黄凯心里的火气更是越来越大，没忍住对着莫夕瑶爆出了粗口。

黄凯的话音刚落，包括重案组的所有人都呆了，熟悉莫夕瑶的人更是一脸呆滞，瞅着黄凯的眼神里都充满了同情，黄凯自己也是一愣，随后脑袋嗡的一声，心里的滋味更是无法言语“我...我他妈的...怎么会对着这个娘们爆粗口？这下算是有好日子过了。”

面对黄凯的咆哮和辱骂，莫夕瑶并没有表现出太多的怒意，此刻她的所有注意力都集中在了楚岩捏在手里的那张黑色卡片上，脑袋里一幕一幕的闪过了无数个可能的画面，直到身边的万彩妮轻轻碰了碰她，她这才从失神中清醒了过来。

“黄组长，南山市敢骂我的人，你是第一个，这一次，我知道你是因为那几起绑架案压力过大，所以我不跟你计较，但是我想你搞清楚，我既然说是误会，就一定是误会，我以我的个人名义，担保他和绑架案无关，这样，够了么？”回过神来，莫夕瑶盯着黄凯，刚才黄凯骂她的时候她的注意力都在那张卡片上，但是，不代表她没听到黄凯骂她，所以现在这样回答，已经算是很给面子了。

“收队！”听到莫夕瑶的话，黄凯心中忍不住松了一口气，别看他是南山市局的重案组组长，但是在莫夕瑶面前，还真是摆不上台面，怒意冲冲的吼了一嗓子之后，带着人一阵风似地离开了银棕榈。

自始至终，楚岩就站在那里，一脸平静的看着事情的发展，这群重案组的人，来也匆匆，去也匆匆，折腾了十来分钟，咖啡厅便回归了平静，莫夕瑶在安抚了客人之后，这才款款来到楚岩面前“先生，请到楼上说话。”

咖啡、美酒、夜色，如果话题不沉重，今晚将会绚烂迷人。

“他...怎么样了？”酒杯放下，轻启红唇，莫夕瑶期待的神色有些紧张。
content_en:
Chu Yan looked at Wan Caini who was holding a silver pistol in front of him, still drinking coffee, and smiled after looking at Wan Caini with his eyes.

"Mr. Kidnapper? Are you talking about me?" Seeing Wan Caini's serious look, Chu Yan put down the coffee in his hand and asked with a puzzled look on his face.

"Isn't it? There is a stack of photos hidden in the pocket, and they are all children. How about it? Have you chosen the target?" Chu Yan's reaction made Wan Caini stunned, but she also knew that she believed the waitress Tina's words, so she needed further testing to know whether this person was a suspect.

"How do you know I have a stack of photos? Oh, I understand, the waitress in white, she told you, right?" Chu Yan instantly understood what was going on. "The waitress probably saw those photos of herself and mistakenly thought she was a kidnapper, so she called the police. But looking at the woman's posture and the freedom of choice of firearms, she is most likely an Interpol or something like that. But, why did the Interpol come to this coffee shop? There is no need for elites at their level to catch the kidnappers, right?"

Wan Caini didn't know what Chu Yan was thinking, but what Wan Caini knew was that the thin but unusually tall man in front of her seemed to really have photos, and those photos meant a lot to him.

"Yes, those are the photos. I really want to know, a man with a mysterious identity, hiding a bunch of bloody photos in his pocket. What does this mean? Forgive me, I am a policeman, so I am very curious about these. If you are not a kidnapper, then, you might as wellTalk to me.If I can accept your explanation, then I think others will accept it too, right?" The smile on Wan Caini's face was full of threats. Of course, the threat of the smile was far less than the shining silver pistol in her hand.

"A special bullet of 51 points, at such a close distance, I think my head will be blown into a rotten watermelon." She said this almost subconsciously, and when Wan Caini heard Chu Yan say these words, she actually became a little nervous, not for anything else, just because of the sentence "A special bullet of 51 points."

Because there are only three most common calibers in Japan, .357, .45 and .50. This pistol of mine was modified by someone who spent a lot of money. The caliber is .51, which is slightly larger than .50. It is the only one in the world.

Wan Caini was very sure that Chu Yan had never touched this gun, nor had he removed the magazine to check the bullets inside. However, she could accurately judge the caliber of her pistol by sight alone. As an Interpol officer, she knew how sinister this vision was, so she felt nervous for no reason.

At the same time, the waitress Tina followed Mo Xiyao and stood nervously on the stairs.

"Mr. Mo, look, it's that man. The way you look at him is so cold, so cool, ahem...why doesn't he look like a bad guy?" The waitress Tina looked at Chu Yan sitting on the sofa, with a resolute face as sharp as a knife, and she was full of righteousness no matter how she looked at him.

"Stop being crazy. Just because a man is handsome, doesn't mean he is a good person. Just wait here. Team Leader Huang from the Crime Unit will be here soon. The kidnapper will be revealed by then. You go downstairs to greet the guests first. When the police arrive, you are responsible for appeasing the guests.Don't cause trouble." Mo Xiyao stood on the stairs and looked carefully at Chu Yan, who was smiling. His best friend Wan Caini was sitting opposite him at the moment. The two seemed to be chatting happily, unless the large pistol in Wan Caini's left hand affected the atmosphere.

"Police! Don't move! Raise your hands high and put them where I can see." Just when Wan Caini was about to continue asking, a group of people rushed into the coffee shop. A dozen Rolock 17 guns that had just been in office for a few days surrounded Chu Yan and Wan Caini like an iron barrel.

"Interpol!" Wan Caini showed her ID. Sure enough, as Chu Yan guessed, she was an elite member of Interpol.

"Self-search!" Huang Kai, the team leader of the Nanshan City Serious Case Group who rushed in immediately, was the first to take back his pistol. This team leader is two meters tall and has a strong build. He is a typical muscular man. However, at this moment, he has not changed his clothes for an unknown period of time, and his slovenly beard and face are filled with evil spirits.He was so angry that his red eyes were as wide as bull's eyes. He stared at Chu Yan fiercely and ordered a search without saying a word. He had received many clues about the crime before, but they were all false alarms. He had to confirm the identity of the suspect and obtain evidence related to the kidnapping case before arresting the suspect.

Looking at the police officers around him, the expression on Chu Yan's face did not change much, but his eyes drifted behind everyone, where Mo Xiyao, the owner of the Silver Palm Cafe, was looking at Chu Yan with hatred.

"Yes!" Police officer Dali said and was about to search him, while Chu Yan looked at him calmly. The coldness in his eyes made Dali's spine a little chilly. But the more it looked like this, the more it showed that the person in front of him was not an ordinary person. Maybe this guy was really a kidnapper. Thinking of Dali, he still stretched his hand to Chu Yan's chest.

"Why are you searching me?" Dali's hands almost touched Chu Yan's clothes, and Chu Yan spoke calmly, his eyes as cold as winter on his calm face.

"Why? I now suspect that you are related to the three kidnapping cases, how about it? Is this reason enough?" After hearing Chu Yan's words, Huang Kai immediately became angry. He came to Chu Yan with blood-red eyes and reached out to poke Chu Yan's shoulder.

"You mean you're just guessing out of thin air? You look at me like a kidnapper, and then you search and arrest me, right?" Chu Yan didn't care about Huang Kai's roar, but anyone could hear the chill in his voice, and Huang Kai's finger stabbed Chu Yan's shoulder heavily after Chu Yan's words came out.

"Okay! You're so fucking stubborn. Since you said you're not a kidnapper, well, take out the photos in your pocket and tell them clearly their origins, and I'll let you go! How about it?" Huang Kai hasn't slept for three days and three nights in a row. Now his whole body is like a powder keg, which is always on fire. So Zhang Dechang, his most capable assistant, pulled the head of the serious crime team aside and swore at Chu Yan!

Chu Yan's eyes were fixed on Mo Xiyao who was standing on the stairs in the distance. Although he had never met her before, he knew that the target of his trip should be that woman. As for these policemen and the Interpol police officer who had run to Mo Xiyao's side at some point, Chu Yan didn't pay too much attention. After all, he knew best whether he was a kidnapper, and a lot of evidence could easily clear him of suspicion.

"Okay." Chu Yan was not ready to continue to tangle with these policemen, so he reached into his pocket to take out the photo and explain clearly. However, before Chu Yan could take out the photo, a black card had already fallen out first. The touch of gold on the black card made Mo Xiyao, who was standing far away, hear a "bang" in his head and almost fell down the stairs.

"Team Leader Huang, I think this may be a misunderstanding." As soon as Mo Xiyao said this, everyone was stunned, especially Huang Kai, the leader of the serious crime team. Mo Xiyao personally called him the police call, otherwise he would not have brought so many brothers to arrest the person.

"Miss Mo, what the hell do you mean? You made the call, and now you say it's a misunderstanding, are you kidding me?" Huang Kai became more and more angry, and couldn't help but swear at Mo Xiyao.

As soon as Huang Kai finished speaking, everyone in the serious crime team was stunned. People who were familiar with Mo Xiyao were even more stunned. Their eyes were full of sympathy when they looked at Huang Kai. Huang Kai himself was also stunned, and then his head buzzed, and the feeling in his heart was even more unspeakable. "I...how the hell...why did I swear at this bitch? Now I have a good life."

Facing Huang Kai's roar and insults, Mo Xiyao did not show much anger. At this moment, all her attention was focused on the black card Chu Yan held in his hand. Countless possible scenes flashed through her mind. It was not until Wan Caini beside her gently touched her that she woke up from her daze.

"Team Leader Huang, you are the first person in Nanshan City who dares to scold me. This time, I know that you are under too much pressure because of those kidnapping cases, so I won't argue with you, but I want you to understand that since I said it was a misunderstanding, it must be a misunderstanding. In my personal name, I willIs that enough to ensure that he has nothing to do with the kidnapping case?" After coming back to her senses, Mo Xiyao stared at Huang Kai. When Huang Kai scolded her just now, her attention was on that card. However, it didn't mean that she didn't hear Huang Kai scolding her, so answering like this now is already a big deal.

"Close the team!" Hearing Mo Xiyao's words, Huang Kai couldn't help but breathed a sigh of relief. Although he was the head of the serious crime team of the Nanshan City Bureau, he really couldn't put himself on the stage in front of Mo Xiyao. After roaring angrily, he led the people away from Silver Palm like a gust of wind.

From the beginning to the end, Chu Yan stood there, watching the development of the matter calmly. The group of people from the serious crime team came and went in a hurry. After ten minutes of tossing, the cafe returned to calm. After Mo Xiyao appeased the guests, she came to Chu Yan and said, "Sir, please come upstairs to talk."

Coffee, wine, and the night, if the topic is not heavy, tonight will be gorgeous and charming.

"How...how is he?" Mo Xiyao put down her wine glass and lightly opened her red lips, looking nervous in anticipation.
